title: Toward a Unified Picture of Confinement and Baryon Structure
summary: In this work, we investigate the infrared structure of quantum chromodynamics from the perspective of the Cho-Faddeev-Niemi decomposition and the Faddeev-Niemi effective theory of Yang-Mills fields. We argue that the topological solitons of the Faddeev-Niemi theory, namely gluon knots characterized by the Hopf invariant, should be regarded as the relevant ground-state degrees of freedom of Yang-Mills theory in the deep infrared region.
